# Master Patterns

> Master Patterns is a modern Computer Science (CS) Pattern Learning Platform & Visualizer. It provides interactive step-by-step visual tracing and multi-language code generation (C, C++, Java, Python, JavaScript) for classic and advanced matrix/symbol pattern programs.

Website: https://master-patterns.vercel.app/
Developer: Asifur Rahaman (https://asifur-rahaman-portfolio.vercel.app/)

## Core Routes & Applications

- [Catalog](https://master-patterns.vercel.app/): Interactive catalog of CS pattern programs with category filters, difficulty tags, and live output previews.
- [Report an Error / Feedback](https://master-patterns.vercel.app/report): Web3Forms-integrated error reporting tool for reporting code syntax errors, rendering issues, or sending feedback.
- [Sitemap](https://master-patterns.vercel.app/sitemap): Descriptive platform index, pattern categorization matrix, and architecture specifications.

## Pattern Categories

- **Star Patterns**: Classic right-angled pyramids, inverted triangles, diamonds, hourglasses, and hollow stars.
- **Number Patterns**: Incrementing pyramids, Pascal's triangle, Floyd's triangle, palindromic number pyramids, and binary alternating matrices.
- **Character / Alphabet Patterns**: Repeated letter pyramids, A-Z sequence grids, and palindromic letter diamonds.
- **Pyramid & Diamond Patterns**: Centered symmetrical pyramids, hollow diamonds, and nested polygon frames.
- **Advanced Matrix Patterns**: Spiral matrices, concentric number squares, snake patterns, and checkerboard grids.

## Code Generators Supported

Master Patterns generates production-grade, formatted source code with configurable loop variables, space padding, and row parameters across 5 languages:
- **C** (`stdio.h`)
- **C++** (`<iostream>`)
- **Java** (`System.out.print`)
- **Python** (`print()`)
- **JavaScript** (`console.log`)

## Technical Specifications

- **Frontend Stack**: React 19, Vite 8, Vanilla CSS Design System with dark and hazy bluish-pink light mode themes.
- **Routing**: Client-side HTML5 History API routing with Vercel single-page app rewrites.
- **Form Submissions**: Web3Forms API endpoint integration (`api.web3forms.com`).
